required_evidence: Determine whether reduced vanishing implies bounded chain contraction.
A legal counterexample must have zero reduced records at every degree, including endpoints.
Any claimed bounded inverse must include an actual quantitative bound or closed-range argument.
critical_errors: Drop closures from the boundary spaces.
Infer a spectral gap or bounded inverse from zero kernel.
Promote strong regularized convergence to an exact bounded inverse or operator-norm convergence.
completion_policy: A valid counterexample refuting the proposed universal target resolves that target. Record constructive progress separately; do not require the author route or every baseline lemma.
open_task_policy: Accept independently verified alternative constructions, counterexamples and unexpected results. Explicit conditional results are valid contributions; silently promoting their scope is not. Honest incompleteness is distinct from an invalid proof.
